info.title: Spring AI RAG Service API
info.description:
General-purpose RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) service framework API.

## Core Capabilities
- **Document Management**: CRUD, batch operations, chunking, embedding vector generation
- **Retrieval**: Vector search + full-text hybrid retrieval with configurable weights
- **Q&A**: Non-streaming + SSE streaming, multi-turn conversation memory
- **Evaluation**: Precision@K / MRR / NDCG retrieval quality metrics
- **A/B Testing**: Experiment framework for comparing retrieval strategies
- **Monitoring**: Alerts, SLO checks, performance benchmarks

## Model-Agnostic
Supports OpenAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic, and other LLMs — switch via configuration.

## API Versioning
All endpoints are prefixed with `/api/v1/`. Breaking changes will be introduced in `/api/v2/`.

## Try It Out
Use the **Try it out** button in Swagger UI to make live API calls.

importId.description: Stable import UUID for a known import root

sourceType.description: Import source type for a known import root

FileTreeResponse.description: Directory listing response with path and entries

path.description: The virtual path that was listed (ends with '/' or is '/')

entries.description: List of direct children (files and directories)

importMetadata.description: Readable metadata for the current UUID import directory

contentPreview.description: Content preview (truncated to 200 chars), present in list view

content.description: Full content, present in detail view

contentSnapshot.description: Content snapshot (only in single version detail, omitted in list)

jsonbPayloadSnapshot.description: JSONB payload snapshot (only in single version detail, omitted in list)

hasMissing.description: Whether any documents are missing embeddings

DataGovernancePolicyResponse.description: Data retention, redaction and cleanup policy visible to the caller

retention.description: Retention and cleanup policy by data category

capabilities.description: Capabilities available to the current caller

retentionDays.description: Retention in whole days; zero means category cleanup is not active

automaticCleanup.description: Whether this category is automatically cleaned

embeddingModel.description: Embedding model used by this collection

sourceRevision.description: Opaque source revision for external synchronization

ClientErrorCountResponse.description: Total count of recorded client-side errors

count.description: Total number of recorded client errors

ChatHistoryResponse.description: A single chat message pair in the session history.

id.description: Unique identifier of the history record.

relatedDocumentIds.description: IDs of documents retrieved and used for this response.

sources.description: Citation sources captured when this turn completed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this message pair was recorded.

hitRate.description: Cache hit rate as a percentage string

details.description: Detailed statistics per collection or content hash

principalRole.description: Database principal role. Null for environment-root and legacy-static principals.

collectionAccessMode.description: Effective Collection access mode for the current principal.

allowedCollectionKeys.description: Stable Collection keys allowed for a restricted principal. Null means unrestricted.

AuditLogResponse.description: Redacted audit log record without operation details or request content

BatchDeleteItem.description: Single item result in batch deletion
